translationSource: Exact bundled data/lang catalogs. zh-Hant is the original XML/UI. Display punctuation comes from the shipped punctuate() implementation; no translations were composed.
captureNotes: Start each route from a fresh new game via visible UI; do not jump directly to a stage.
Between listed choices, advance the story until the next choice or targetText appears.
Stop at targetText before later branch choices or endings. The targets are early, clothed character interactions.
storyLineNumber is the 1-based raw XML story line, not a fixed number of UI clicks.
The eight scenes deliberately cover bar, laboratory, cafe, beach, office, campus and street settings.
